# The Leopard Seal — full-length VISUAL WORKPRINT

**Not a final film / not a complete audio master.** Original narration section 04 could not be generated by the speech tool. It remains unmodified. This workprint labels that omission on screen, carries the exact section-04 words as temporary captions, and uses 61 seconds of explicitly silent placeholder audio. That chapter's final duration and edit will need conformance when its narration becomes available. The other nine original recordings play at their native speed. No substitute narrator, rewriting, fragments, obfuscation or alternate synthesis route was used.

The supplied script, including the last call to action, is byte-identical to the original. SHA-256: `12e7342195250a4484ad32e7f4ad30a4b7a35025cb46d06f12d44e51b85568fe`. Headings and bracketed visual instructions are not spoken. `NARRATION_ORIGINAL.srt` is derived from the original text, not substituted ASR wording. Its timings are approximately aligned to the existing recordings; section 04 timings are estimates.

## Screen-media provenance and attribution

- **Leopard seal:** original subject-specific parametric 3D geometry and spotted-skin material. Articulated shared jaw hinge, 32 tooth crowns with three-cusped postcanines, paired fore/hind flippers and no dorsal fin. Not a generated PNG puppet and not a scientific scan. Penguins, fish, krill, secondary seal, horse, small boat, ice, equipment and animations are newly authored explanatory 3D reconstructions. They are not actual event footage, animal intentions, measured hunting tracks or individual likenesses.
- **Snow Rig (CC), Snow v4 — Blender Foundation / Blender Studio / Demeter Dzadik.** Publisher: https://studio.blender.org/characters/snow/v4/ . CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ . Uses the previously approved converted, clothed 60-bone production rig and atlas; generic human cast, not likenesses of Paul Nicklen, Kirsty Brown or Gareth Wood. New poses, camera grip, head-attached diving equipment, hood and lighting. Facial-rig animation is not claimed.
- **Killer whale — Junskie Pastilan / pasilan.** https://blendswap.com/blend/7791 . CC BY 3.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/ . Bundled glTF obtained via the previously documented WebGL Fundamentals mirror. Geometry normalization, articulated jaw, swimming deformation, composition/material/light modifications are production derivatives.
- **Rothera-01.jpg — Carina Gsottbauer, January 2026.** Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Rothera-01.jpg . Original: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/0/03/Rothera-01.jpg . CC BY-SA 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/ . The full original image is fitted to the frame without crop, with contextual text/credit overlays. It is contemporary site context, NOT a photograph of the 2003 incident. The photo and any adaptation of it retain CC BY-SA 4.0; no exclusive rights or removal of share-alike obligations is asserted. Section 06 uses this quiet real still, not an animated reconstruction. `Rothera-05.jpg`, same author/license/month, is retained as an unused source and is not represented as appearing in the film. Original hashes and provenance are in `assets/archive/ARCHIVE.json`.
- **Natural Earth 110m land geometry — public domain.** https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/ . Real geographic vectors are used; study markers are explanatory and not navigation or measured animal tracks.
- **Three.js r170 / Water, three-mesh-bvh:** MIT; original notices and water-normal attribution remain in the existing self-contained production kit. **Bricolage Grotesque / DM Sans:** bundled documentary fonts, OFL notices retained in the kit. **Playwright / esbuild / FFmpeg** retain their respective upstream licensing; tool usage does not imply ownership of third-party media.
- The five-sound song illustration is NOT a field recording or measured spectrogram. No music or field sound has been fabricated and presented as authentic.

## Execution and QA boundaries

All rendering, screenshot extraction, audio processing, montage and encoding run on GitHub Actions in the existing repository `touilhasan12-png/YOU-DOC`, isolated branch `leopard-seal-v1`. No old-film media is a fallback. The full edit has 10 chapters and 71 deliberately placed source-text-anchored shots, native 1920×1080 at 24 fps. The film plan is not proof that rendering succeeded: see the actual workflow, actual chapter reports, actual frame probes, and final delivery report.

Automated checks compare original hashes, rendered frame counts and final decoded audio against the nine native recordings. ASR is an approximate secondary check, not perfect word verification, natural-pronunciation acceptance or continuous human listening. Actual frame review does not establish every-frame artistic approval or universal mesh collision freedom. Workprint status remains visible throughout, including the missing narration notice throughout chapter 04.

The completed earlier film, old production-kit ZIP/master and their Drive folders are unchanged. This is a separate production.
